# Formed contacts change copying fidelity

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every alphabet and law of draws: a copy attaching at each site what its contacts read there produces a word exactly when every site reads the word's token, the pool supplies the word and the support covers what it draws, and its product only grows; for every process an output is extended along every course exactly when every step extends it, and a quantity kept by every ungated step is kept along every ungated course. In the contact machine, for every state, as many copy moves as a word has tokens extend the product by that word exactly when each site reads its token through the actual contacts, the pool supplies it and the support covers what it draws; complete stable contacts recovering prior copying are the instance; every course keeps the product's bonds the path on its tokens, so complete contacts copy the template, bonds included, exactly when its bonds are that path. Loss, displacement and rebinding change the successor by changing what sites read; only copy moves change the product, so contact changes never rewrite it, and every admitted finite history keeps its built prefix and its totals of connectors, material and support. Contact formation consuming connectors and support enters material copying.

Canonical source: [CopyingRegistration.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/CopyingRegistration.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Indexed sites, selective docking, reliable transduction, local attachment costs and event occurrence are supplied; there is no excision or replacement of built material.
- The general inheritance composition requires every value read through complete contacts and template/prefix/suffix consistency, retaining the prior path and material/support premises (the nonempty premise is not needed).

Roles differentiate through docking, reading, transfers and retention in common activity; reading through contacts consists of actual position pairs, not a success flag. Local discrimination remains supplied by the equal-index docking guard.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

33 new theorem declarations / 54 new audits, with 430 inherited declarations separate in 484 actual-closure audits. The original paper is reread as the existing comparator, without new empirical reanalysis. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Indexed recognition/transduction, damage rates, repair initiation, excision, autonomous provision and population selection are not derived; a strong rival retaining the same contact mechanism has the same explanatory capacity.

- Missing contacts stall despite stock/support; displacement need not change the value, rebinding does not rewrite old output, and matched contact counts/full copying state can produce different sequences.
